title: Participant Perspective and Contradiction Tracking Across Multi-Event Sequence
objective: Track three library branch stakeholders across a budget cut event without collapsing their divergent viewpoints

constraints: Contradictions must remain explicit in state

rubric.requirement_satisfaction: All 3 perspectives tracked with respective unresolved priorities
rubric.continuity: Stakeholder identities maintained across successive turns
rubric.useful_novelty: Structured conflict mapping without artificial closure
